column3: The clause having been killed is omitted.
“Had a child stand” renders took and set a child.
“Else” is supplied; tried to stop interprets were forbidding.
The name is construed as the name borne by Christ’s people.
BSB omits this verse with the critical text; it appears in the Textus Receptus (“where their worm does not die, and the fire is not quenched”).
